outcome: Prevalence of analgesia use during labor
cohort: 221,345 women who had a vaginal birth, from the WHO Multicountry Survey on Maternal and Newborn Health
finding: The use of labor analgesia was low (4%), particularly in low-HDI countries, and was associated with higher education levels, nulliparity, and previous cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: This study found that women who had previous cesarean deliveries were significantly more likely to receive analgesia during labor.
